strings.zh: 小茜『真是不要脸的台长{NEWLINE}和厚脸皮的冠军！{CLEAR}我跟你们没什么好谈的,哼！
strings.en: Whitney: What a shameless director,{NEWLINE}and what a brazen Champion!{SCROLL}I’ve got nothing to say to either of{NEWLINE}you. Hmph!

strings.zh: 台长『小茜馆主别走啊,{NEWLINE}第二期节目的事还要拜托你呢。
strings.en: Director: Whitney, please don’t go! We{NEWLINE}still need you for the second episode!

strings.zh: 胡桃『你好啊,{VAR:0103:0}大人,{NEWLINE}今天咱们节目的主题是{CLEAR}「最强训练家」。{CLEAR}您可以给咱们听友回忆一下{CLEAR}您是如何一路成长为最强训练家的吗？
strings.en: Mary: Hello, {VAR:0103:0}!{NEWLINE}The theme of today’s show is ‘The{CLEAR}Strongest Trainer.’{SCROLL}Could you tell our listeners how you{NEWLINE}grew into the strongest Trainer?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我当时从真新镇出发,{NEWLINE}在大木博士那里{CLEAR}选了第一个伙伴小火龙。{CLEAR}然后我们一起前往常磐市。{CLEAR}当时什么都不知道,{CLEAR}小绿还约我直接去挑战精灵联盟,{CLEAR}结果被人家门卫给赶回来了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I set out from Pallet Town,{NEWLINE}and at Prof. Oak’s lab I chose my first{CLEAR}partner, Charmander.{SCROLL}Then we headed to Viridian{NEWLINE}City together.{SCROLL}I didn’t know anything back then.{NEWLINE}Blue even talked me into going straight{CLEAR}to challenge the Pokémon League,{SCROLL}and the guard sent us right back home.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我当时从真新镇出发,{NEWLINE}在大木博士那里{CLEAR}选了第一个伙伴皮卡丘。{CLEAR}然后我们一起前往常磐市。{CLEAR}当时什么都不知道,{CLEAR}小绿还约我直接去挑战精灵联盟,{CLEAR}结果被人家门卫给赶回来了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I set out from Pallet Town,{NEWLINE}and at Prof. Oak’s lab I chose my first{CLEAR}partner, Pikachu.{SCROLL}Then we headed to Viridian{NEWLINE}City together.{SCROLL}I didn’t know anything back then.{NEWLINE}Blue even talked me into going straight{CLEAR}to challenge the Pokémon League,{SCROLL}and the guard sent us right back home.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我当时从真新镇出发,{NEWLINE}在大木博士那里{CLEAR}选了第一个伙伴妙蛙种子。{CLEAR}然后我们一起前往常磐市。{CLEAR}当时什么都不知道,{CLEAR}小绿还约我直接去挑战精灵联盟,{CLEAR}结果被人家门卫给赶回来了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I set out from Pallet Town,{NEWLINE}and at Prof. Oak’s lab I chose my first{CLEAR}partner, Bulbasaur.{SCROLL}Then we headed to Viridian{NEWLINE}City together.{SCROLL}I didn’t know anything back then.{NEWLINE}Blue even talked me into going straight{CLEAR}to challenge the Pokémon League,{SCROLL}and the guard sent us right back home.

strings.zh: 胡桃『哈哈,谁都有过{NEWLINE}刚出道时的青涩阶段呢,{CLEAR}连我们的冠军大人也不例外。{SCROLL}胡桃『那第一场让您印象深刻的战斗{NEWLINE}是在哪里跟谁展开的呢？
strings.en: Mary: Ha ha! Everyone goes through a{NEWLINE}green phase when they’re starting out.{CLEAR}Even our Champion!{SCROLL}Mary: So, where was the first{NEWLINE}battle that really stuck with you,{CLEAR}and who was it against?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我记得当时我们一行人{NEWLINE}在月见山第一次遇到火箭队……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I remember when our{NEWLINE}group first ran into Team Rocket at{CLEAR}Mt. Moon...

strings.zh: 胡桃『真是一段传奇的训练家经历！{NEWLINE}谢谢冠军大人来到我们广播台{CLEAR}为大家讲述自己的故事,谢谢您！
strings.en: Mary: What a legendary journey!{SCROLL}Thank you so much for coming to our{NEWLINE}station to share your story with{CLEAR}everyone, Champion!

strings.zh: 胡桃『好了,录音到此结束。{NEWLINE}冠军大人您可以稍微放松一下了。
strings.en: Mary: All right, that’s a wrap.{NEWLINE}You can relax now, Champion.

strings.zh: 台长『真是太感谢您了,冠军大人。{NEWLINE}「最强训练家」这个节目{CLEAR}在您的帮助下一定会大获成功！{CLEAR}为了感谢您这次参与我们节目录制,{CLEAR}这点小小的礼物请您务必收下。
strings.en: Director: Thank you so much, Champion.{NEWLINE}With your help, ‘The Strongest Trainer’{CLEAR}is sure to be a huge success!{SCROLL}As thanks for taking part in the{NEWLINE}recording, please accept this{CLEAR}little gift.

strings.zh: 台长『以后欢迎您常来{NEWLINE}我们广播台参观指导,{CLEAR}我们将不胜荣幸！
strings.en: Director: You’re welcome to visit{NEWLINE}and give us your guidance any time.{CLEAR}We’d be truly honored!

strings.zh: 台长『胡桃小姐,新节目的后续编辑{NEWLINE}就请你费心了。
strings.en: Director: Miss Mary, I’ll leave the{NEWLINE}editing of the new show to you.

strings.zh: 胡桃『好的台长,我一定用心做好。
strings.en: Mary: Yes, Director.{NEWLINE}I’ll do my very best.

strings.zh: 台长『嗯,拜托了。
strings.en: Director: Mm, I’m counting on you.

strings.zh: 呃,台长和小茜馆主{NEWLINE}似乎还没有商量好……
strings.en: Um, it seems the director and Whitney{NEWLINE}still haven’t sorted things out...

strings.zh: 广播节目的幕后工作也是很累人的。
strings.en: The behind-the-scenes work on radio{NEWLINE}shows is exhausting too.

strings.zh: 很多广播节目其实都是录播,{NEWLINE}就是提前把声音录好,{CLEAR}经过加工剪辑之后再播放给听众。
strings.en: Many radio shows are{NEWLINE}actually prerecorded.{SCROLL}We record the voices ahead of time,{NEWLINE}then edit them before airing them{CLEAR}to listeners.

strings.zh: 吸盘魔偶『Miii——me！
strings.en: Mr. Mime: Miii-me!

strings.zh: 阿波罗『哦？这么快就打开安全门了？
strings.en: Archer: Oh? You opened the security{NEWLINE}door that quickly?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『阿波罗……{NEWLINE}你是负责在这里阻挡我们前进的吗？{CLEAR}既然如此就亮出你的精灵吧！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Archer... Are you here to{NEWLINE}stop us from going any farther?{SCROLL}Then send out your Pokémon!

strings.zh: 阿波罗『不不不,我只是在这里{NEWLINE}确认你们当前的位置。{CLEAR}既然你们已经突破了最后的安全门,{CLEAR}那我也该上塔顶向坂木老大报告了。
strings.en: Archer: No, no, no. I’m only here to{NEWLINE}confirm your current position.{SCROLL}Now that you’ve broken through the{NEWLINE}last security door, I should go up to{CLEAR}the roof and report to Boss Giovanni.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『确认我们的位置？{NEWLINE}这是要干什么……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Confirm our position?{NEWLINE}What is this about...?

strings.zh: 火箭队把我的午餐三明治抢走了,{NEWLINE}这下要饿肚子了……
strings.en: Team Rocket took my lunch sandwich...{NEWLINE}Now I’m going to go hungry...

strings.zh: 小葵『什么？今天的暗语？{SCROLL}小葵『当然是「救命」啦！
strings.en: Buena: What? Today’s password?{SCROLL}Buena: HELP, of course!

strings.zh: 胡桃『冠军大人,请阻止火箭队,{NEWLINE}不要让他们胡作非为！
strings.en: Mary: Champion, please stop Team{NEWLINE}Rocket! Don’t let them get away{CLEAR}with this!

strings.zh: 火箭队拿了一套音响设备{NEWLINE}上了广播塔顶,{CLEAR}是准备做直播吗？
strings.en: Team Rocket took a set of audio{NEWLINE}equipment up to the top of the{CLEAR}Radio Tower. Are they planning a{CLEAR}live broadcast?
